text: System Duo（DSH Web 插件）：为 DeepSeek Harness 加入 System One 决策模型，并配置 vllm-sr/auto。它在请求、工具调用前后和回合结束时运行判断，并提供批量分析及截图工具。功能包括请求分流、工具审阅、结果筛查与隐私遮罩、完成检查，以及文件或图片评分。适合希望在 DSH 中加入自动判断和模型路由的用户。可自动获取 app.vllm-sr.ai 凭据，也可设置 VLLM_SR_API_KEY。

System Duo adds fast decision models and vllm-sr/auto to DSH. It triages requests, reviews tool calls, screens results, checks completion, and provides batch and screenshot tools. Credentials are fetched from app.vllm-sr.ai or supplied through VLLM_SR_API_KEY.

@vllm-sr/dsh 的功能「请求分流」：每条用户请求进入 agent 步骤时，插件对任务类型、工作量、清晰度和风险作判断，并向模型提供相应提示。
@vllm-sr/dsh 的功能「工具调用检查」：配置的工具执行前，插件将请求、工作区和调用内容交给决策模型判断，并根据结果继续或拦截。
@vllm-sr/dsh 的功能「批量内容判断」：System Two 可调用 system_one，对文件、文本、记录或图片按同一组问题批量分类、评分或提取结果。
@vllm-sr/dsh 的功能「截图理解」：调用 system_one_screen 并传入截图和查找目标、问题或预期内容，可获得目标位置及屏幕判断。
@vllm-sr/dsh 的功能「配置默认模型」：随插件 bundle 配置 vllm-sr provider 和 vllm-sr/auto 默认模型；用户 profile patch 可以覆盖该配置。
@vllm-sr/dsh 使用前须知：决策请求发往 app.vllm-sr.ai；README 说明请求内容会发送给 System Duo 服务。
@vllm-sr/dsh 使用前须知：自动获取的凭据会写入 DSH 凭据存储及用户 .env 文件，使用前应阅读服务方条款与隐私说明。

@vllm-sr/dsh README · Introduction：

System Duo

@vllm-sr/dsh gives your DeepSeek Harness agent a System One: fast decision models that triage, guard, shield, mask and check every step, while System Two, vllm-sr/auto, thinks it through.
@vllm-sr/dsh README · Introduction：

@vllm-sr/dsh README · Quick start：```bash
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh plugin --profile web add @vllm-sr/dsh
dsh web
```

On its first run the plugin fetches its own free key from [System Duo](https://app.vllm-sr.ai), for research and
evaluation use ([terms](https://app.vllm-sr.ai/terms), [privacy](https://app.vllm-sr.ai/privacy)), and makes
`vllm-sr/auto` your default model. You need Node 24.9 or later; the first line installs DeepSeek Harness and pnpm,
which `dsh plugin` uses to install plugins.

@vllm-sr/dsh README · What System One does in your agent loop：Five reflexes run on their own, and two tools are there when System Two needs them. Every card below is a real one
from the demo recordings: each number is System One's answer in that run.
section: What System One does in your agent loop

text:
@vllm-sr/dsh README · What System One does in your agent loop：
Triage · every request
Reads each request first. A bare “Fix it.” gets a question back.

 Guard · before each tool call
Asks before risky commands. A force-push waits for you: Dangerous, 2.00 of 3.
section: What System One does in your agent loop

@vllm-sr/dsh README · What System One does in your agent loop：
Shield · after each tool result
Strips hidden instructions before System Two reads them: 284 characters from one README.

 Privacy · after each tool result, on by default
Masks personal data as [LABEL] before System Two sees it: 29 details in one file.

Done-check · when a turn ends
Backs “done” with evidence, complete 0.99 and checked 1.00, or sends the turn back.

 system_one · when System Two asks
Typed questions over records and images: 230 tickets routed, scored and flagged in 7.0 s.

text: @vllm-sr/dsh README · See it live：

@vllm-sr/dsh README · See it live：Open **[app.vllm-sr.ai/#harness](https://app.vllm-sr.ai/#harness)** and press **Start DeepSeek Harness**: 21 real
sessions recorded with this plugin open in your browser, read-only, with each System One card where it happened.
Fifteen run in the Web UI, from batch triage of 230 tickets to a judge scoring subject lines; six drive a full desktop
with mail, a spreadsheet, Gitea, an admin console and a web store. Then try your own in a sandbox, on a free key.
@vllm-sr/dsh README · How it works：

@vllm-sr/dsh README · How it works：- **System One, fast.** The Decision Models answer typed questions with calibrated probabilities in a fraction of a
  second: is this command dangerous, does this file give the agent orders, is the work really done. By default
  `vllm-sr/d3-ultra` triages, scores Shield's passages and answers the `system_one` tool, and `vllm-sr/vela3-turbo`
  runs Guard, Privacy, the done-check, every span answer and the screen.
- **System Two, slow.** `vllm-sr/auto` plans, reasons and acts, picking the right open model for each request. The
  plugin makes it your default model; choose any other model in the app and System One keeps working beside it.
- **One router.** vLLM Semantic Router serves System One and routes System Two at
  [app.vllm-sr.ai](https://app.vllm-sr.ai), and both take the one free key the plugin fetches. The router works with
  any model, open or closed.

@vllm-sr/dsh README · Configuration：It works as installed. To change it, set fields on the `system-one` row of your profile's patch,
`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (or `headless`):

```yaml
- id: system-one
  config:
    privacy: true      # mask personal data before System Two reads it; false turns it off
    triage: true       # each reflex and tool can be turned off

@vllm-sr/dsh README · Configuration：**Your key** is kept in DeepSeek Harness's credential store and in `~/.dsh/.env`, readable by you only. In CI, set
`VLLM_SR_API_KEY` to a key from [app.vllm-sr.ai](https://app.vllm-sr.ai); a key you set yourself is always used and
never replaced.

Every option, the questions the tools take, what Chat shows and its selectors, what is sent where, and what we
measured: **[the full reference](https://github.com/Xunzhuo/dsh-system-one-plugin/blob/main/docs/reference.md)**.

@vllm-sr/dsh README · FAQ：**Is it free?** Yes, for research and evaluation: the plugin fetches a free key, and commercial use is not permitted
([terms](https://app.vllm-sr.ai/terms)).

@vllm-sr/dsh README · FAQ：**What leaves my machine?** What System One decides about: your request (clipped), the tool calls it reviews, the
passages of tool results it screens, the end of each turn, and what System Two hands its tools. Privacy sends the
results it masks to System One whole, and System Two gets the conversation, as any LLM provider does. System Duo logs
requests to improve its services and train models, so read its [privacy page](https://app.vllm-sr.ai/privacy) before
you use it with private code or data. Every reflex can be turned off, and the local trace never records keys.

@vllm-sr/dsh README · FAQ：**What if System One is unreachable?** Your agent carries on. A guarded call falls back to `guardOnError` (`allow` by
default) while DeepSeek Harness's own sandbox and approvals still apply, and a tool call that finds System One
unavailable shows one calm **Unavailable** line.

**Why didn't I get the newest release?** pnpm, which `dsh plugin add` uses, installs a release only once it is a day
old. To take one sooner, name its version, as `@vllm-sr/dsh@<version>`.

@vllm-sr/dsh README · FAQ：**I had `dsh-system-one` 0.2.** Run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-system-one`, then add `@vllm-sr/dsh`; your
keys and your `system-one` settings stay.
